'''Lee Hyang-sook'''<!--Note: I am finding it written "Hyang-sook" almost everywhere, including her research publications. The alternative spelling I found is "Hyang Sook" but thus far only seen that on the Ewha page for the current president.--> ({{Korean|hangul=이향숙}}; born 1963) is a professor of mathematics and the 18th president of [[Ewha Womans University]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.newsis.com/view/NISI20250124_0020674367 |script-title=ko:취임사 하는 이향숙 총장 |author= 김혜진 |date= 24 January 2025 |website= [[Newsis]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> with a planned four years in the position of president.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.chosun.com/national/education/2025/01/24/OCE5GHEIPVCYPH6SQOGPZQ3YDE/ |script-title=ko:이향숙 이화여대 신임 총장 24일 취임식 |author= 김승범 |date= 24 January 2025 |website= [[The Chosun Ilbo]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> She was also the first female president of the [[Korean Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.womennews.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=95573 |script-title=ko:대한수학회 첫 여성 회장 이향숙 교수 |author= 이하나 |date= 7 July 2016 |website=[[The Women's News]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>

==Education==
Lee majored in mathematics graduating from Ewha Womans University with a B.S. and M.S. and then [[Northwestern University]] with a Ph.D.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/38190038700|title=Hyang-Sook Lee |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers|IEEE]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= }}</ref>

==Career==
After graduation, Lee returned to Ewha teaching and conducting research and in the Department of Mathematics. In addition to her teaching responsibilities, she has held various other positions at Ewha; including president of the Graduate School Alumnae Association, director of both the Institute of Mathematical Science and Center for Entrepreneurship, CEO of Technology Holdings, vice president of research, and the 18th president.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.ewha.ac.kr/ewhaen/intro/profile01.do |title= Education and Experiences: The 18th President of Ewha Womans University |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Ewha Womans University]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= English}}</ref> Inaugurated on February 1, 2025, Lee is the first president of Ewha Womans University from a science and engineering background.<ref>{{Cite web |title=KoreaWho All About the Leaders Driving the Korean Economy |url=https://www.koreawho.com/ |access-date=2026-03-16 |website=www.koreawho.com |language=en}}</ref> In March 2026, Lee announced that Ewha would be launching 55 new courses in [[artificial intelligence]] to support women interested in the field.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Choi |first=In-jun |date=March 10, 2026 |title=Ewha Womans University launches 55 AI courses for female talent |url=https://www.msn.com/en-xl/news/other/ewha-womans-university-adds-55-ai-courses-for-female-talent/ar-AA1XV3rH?cvid=e6321a23ed7248258410a462cbb0eab8&ocid=hpmsn&apiversion=v2&domshim=1&noservercache=1&noservertelemetry=1&batchservertelemetry=1&renderwebcomponents=1&wcseo=1&bundles=feat-display-admon-bundle |access-date=2026-03-16 |website=www.msn.com}}</ref> She is also credited with the foundation of Ewha's Institute of Multiscale Materials and Systems (IMMS), which will invest 10 million won into interdisciplinary research in energy and intelligence over the next 10 years.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Daily |first=The Chosun |date=2026-01-23 |title=Ewha Womans University Launches Multiscale Materials Research Institute |url=https://www.chosun.com/english/national-en/2026/01/23/C4UNBLD56FAJJCXMDSEDQ5EGQI/ |access-date=2026-03-16 |website=The Chosun Daily |language=en}}</ref>

Outside of Ewha, she has been a board member of the Basic Science Academic Council ({{Korean|hangul=기초과학학회협의체|labels=no}})<!--Ewha site refers to it as Council of Basic Science Societie-->, [[Institute for Basic Science]],<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.ibs.re.kr/kor/sub01_03_02.do |script-title=ko:이사회 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Institute for Basic Science]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> [[National Research Foundation of Korea]], National Research Council of Science & Technology, Basic Research Advisory Committee of the National Science and Technology Advisory Council, Korea Federation of Women's Science & Technology Association, and the  Association of Korean Woman Scientist and Engineers. She was also vice president of both the Korea Institute of Information Security & Cryptology ({{Korean|hangul=한국정보보호학회 부회장|labels=no}}) and Volunteers for Educational Services in Asia, along with president of the Korean Mathematical Society<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kci.go.kr/kciportal/po/search/poInsiSearSoceViewPopup.kci?insiGeneInfoBean.insiId=INS000000953&insiGeneInfoBean.gubunCaseNo=13&isPop=Y |script-title=ko:대한수학회 |author= <!--Not stated--> |title=KCI |date= |website= [[Korea Citation Index]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> and the Korean Association of Mathematical Societies ({{Korean|hangul=한국수학관련단체총연합회 회장|labels=no}}).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.imaeil.com/page/view/2018022600591223523 |script-title=ko:한국수학관련단체총연합회 "수능 수학 가형 출제에서 '기하' 빼서는 안돼" |author= 이석수 |date= 26 February 2018 |website= [[Maeil Business Newspaper]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.khan.co.kr/article/201608232112015 |script-title=ko:대한수학회 첫 여성 회장 이향숙 교수 "미래 일자리 20%가 수학 관련…더 나은 미래에 투자를" |author= 이명희 |date= 24 August 2016 |website= [[Kyunghyang Shinmun]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref> Lee is the first female president of the Korean Mathematical Society.<ref>{{Cite web |title=KoreaWho All About the Leaders Driving the Korean Economy |url=https://www.koreawho.com/ |access-date=2026-03-16 |website=www.koreawho.com |language=en}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
[[File:이향숙 총장님 사진.jpg|thumb|Lee Hyang-sook poses for a photo.]]
* 2023: {{ill|Seoul City Cultural Award|ko|서울특별시 문화상}}<ref>{{cite web |url=https://nature.ewha.ac.kr/naturea/data/natural-history-news.do?mode=view&articleNo=699555&article.offset=20&articleLimit=10 |title= 이향숙 교수, 서울시 문화상 학술부문 수상 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= November 2023|website= College of Natural Sciences |publisher= [[Ewha Womans University]] |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.kms.or.kr/board/list.html?num=23839&start=0&sort=top%20desc,%20reg_dt%20desc&code=news2&tcode=&key=&keyword= |title= 이향숙 교수(이화여대), 2023년도 제72회 서울특별시 문화상 수상 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 29 November 2023  |website= [[Korean Mathematical Society]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.eroun.net/news/articleView.html?idxno=38157 |title= '서울시 문화상' 11명...학술 부문 이향숙 이화여자대학교 교수 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 20 October 2023 |website= 이로운넷 |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2023: Distinguished Alumni Award, Mathematics Department, Ewha Womans University
* 2021: Service Award, Korean Mathematical Society<ref>{{cite web |url= https://m.dongascience.com/news.php?idx=50011 |script-title=ko:대한수학회 올해 학술상에 KAIST 곽시종 교수 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= 20 October 2021  |website= [[Donga Science]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2020–2023: Research Excellence Award, Ewha Womans University
* 2016: [[Woman Scientist/Engineer of the Year Award]], Korea Foundation for Women In Science, Engineering and Technology<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.hankyung.com/news/article/201612289131g |script-title=ko:[동정] '올해의 여성과학기술자상' 이향숙 이화여대 교수 |author= 김봉구 |date= 28 December 2016 |website= [[The Korea Economic Daily]] |publisher= |access-date= 7 February 2025 |quote= |language= Korean}}</ref>
* 2013–2016: Research Excellence Award, Ewha Womans University
* 2015: Special Service Award, Korean Mathematical Society
